prompts.label: A｜景色を主役に
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, shippable high-fidelity portrait iPhone WORK SESSION screen for a Japanese lofi pixel-art focus app. Image 1 is the EXACT BACKGROUND ARTWORK and mandatory composition reference. It shows a small silver-haired girl working at a rooftop desk in the lower part, warm lamp, plants, nearer apartments, road and night sky. Preserve the girl's size and position and the composition/style/colors of this supplied artwork. Use it full screen, edge to edge, retaining aspect ratio with only the smallest crop if needed; no image card, no decorative frame, no invented scenery or future skyline. Overlay a refined functional UI, don't redraw the illustration. One complete portrait screenshot approx 9:19.5, front-on, no phone hardware, no perspective, no collage or external annotation. This is the main WORK screen, not a modal, not a collection/detail/story screen.
Shared required features and exact state across all proposals:
- Scene title "ネオンの向こうの屋上".
- Current rank "4/5" only (no prefix レベル or RANK).
- A fine visible rank-evolution progress bar at about 75%, distinct from the stopwatch. Optional small caption "進化まであと7分" only if specified in the variant.
- ACTIVE elapsed stopwatch "18:42", counting UP, not countdown. No task-duration selection, no pomodoro presets, no start button in this active session.
- A clear accessible pause button using the pause icon, plus a separate finish action "作業を終える" (or short "終了" only where variant specifies). Do not combine finishing with pausing.
- The music name "Night Signal" is an audio-settings touch target. Include the app's signature pale white low-opacity audio spectrum as ONLY THE LEFT HALF OF A CIRCLE, centered exactly on the physical RIGHT SCREEN EDGE so it appears to emerge from the edge. Thin radial strokes, restrained, about 15–20% white opacity, no colorful spectrum. Song name right-aligned close to the edge. No standalone audio settings button.
- Bottom navigation for three destinations with thin icons and Japanese labels "作業", "コレクション", "設定"; 作業 selected. No fourth tab.
- UI toggles manually on background tap and does not time out; show the visible UI state. Do not add written instructions about that.
Palette: mostly black and actual artwork, warm ivory/soft white typography and very restrained champagne interactive accents, muted gray for secondary text. No neon colored UI, no bright white cards, no new product features, no motivational slogans, no weather controls, no tasks, no extra statistics. Genuine 44pt touch targets, crisp Japanese text, carefully aligned spacing and safe areas. Keep the central scene and especially the girl's head and hands unobstructed. Do not globally darken or blur the artwork: only subtle top/bottom readability scrims behind UI. This should look like a carefully designed premium iOS app, not a sci-fi HUD or gaming dashboard. Exact required text only, do not add English headings other than the track title. Keep status bar and home indicator subtle. DESIGN A — AIRY EDITORIAL OVERLAY. Place the scene title elegantly upper-left below the status-bar safe area, with the small 4/5 label and thin short 75%-filled growth bar beneath. No enclosing header card and no big title underline. Keep the middle two-thirds almost entirely artwork. The half-circle spectrum emerges from the right edge around the vertical midpoint, with the right-aligned track title subtly overlapping its center; understated enough to leave the art dominant. Near the bottom, BELOW the girl's face/hands, place a bare text stopwatch 18:42 at lower left, a restrained small caption "経過時間" above it, and a warm ivory circular pause button to its right. The finish action is a small quiet text button aligned nearby, not a second big filled button. All these sit directly over a subtle bottom fade, with NO timer container card. Navigation at the very bottom is a thin minimal row of three line icons plus labels with no thick pill background, selected 作業 indicated by a tiny champagne dot or a short fine line. Overall beautiful typography and breathing room, UI feels almost weightless.
